policy.continuum: Report the larger sideband count density scaled to the signal width. Require an excess over each side separately to avoid a one-sided continuum edge masquerading as a line.
policy.range_rule: Direction has no radial coordinate; the finite plane fixes z rather than fitting it. No source range is identified by these saved maps.
policy.scope: Posthoc compatibility screening of three specified gamma lines; not an unrestricted isotope identification or calibrated discovery test.
policy.screen_model: For each sideband, independent equal-rate Poisson signal/side counts imply a conditional Binomial(N, signal_width/(signal_width+side_width)) upper tail. Six comparisons cover three lines and two sidebands.
policy.selection: Whole bins selected by their centers. Both left and right sideband comparisons must pass; no rebinning, gain fitting or energy shift.
policy.statistics_limit: Pulse groups from one initial decay may be correlated. Local continuum may be curved or contain other lines. These count-model probabilities are screening diagnostics, not calibrated physical discovery probabilities or isotope posterior probabilities.

provenance.validation_scope: Exact saved manifest, summary/maps/cone bytes and frozen plan; no raw/native replay and no changes to the existing analysis.

references.note: The frozen campaign uses the 661.657-keV level/transition anchor; the 0.002-keV recoil difference is far below its 2-keV bins. No frozen value is changed.
